headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low despite extreme geopolitical Stress
body: Friday ended with two-sided Nasdaq price discovery. NQ is closed for the weekend, so no live extension, failed-retracement, or session-extreme structure can be observed. Fresh U.S.-Iran sanctions developments, impaired Strait of Hormuz oil flows, and renewed Russia-Ukraine drone escalation keep Stress extreme without constituting an observed pathological Nasdaq price path.

outlookSummary: The exact next 24 hours remain inside the weekend futures closure and end before the Sunday 22:00 UTC Globex reopening.
